title: AuditEventDeviceRemovedFromOrg
description:
The data structure that represents the event data for a device removed from organization audit event.

Introduced in Apple Business API 2.6.

releaseEntityId.description: The unique id of the releasing entity. In the case of releaseEntityType == USER this property is intentionally not populated since it’s already given by SUBJECT_TYPE and SUBJECT_ID.

releaseEntityType.description: The type of entity that conducted the release/disown operation.

serialNumber.description: Serial number of the device, unique to that device.
